transcript:
Interviewer: This intake is for the Republic of Alderhaven, a fictional demonstration jurisdiction.
Caller: The current visits run on Saturday from 16:00 to 20:00. That is the old arrangement.
Caller: I am Bera Moss and the other parent is Tovin Moss.
Caller: My home address is 9 Lantern Court, Sampletown.
Caller: Our child is Elin Moss born 2016-11-28.
Caller: The existing order is dated 2021-01-19.
Caller: This is the change I want: Change visits because I now work Saturday evenings.
Interviewer: Please state the replacement schedule, rather than the current one.
Caller: Sunday visits from 10:00 to 16:00.
